title: TV ghost hunter summons spirits at 'haunted' Oxfordshire farm
excerpt: Most Haunted host and paranormal investigator Yvette Fielding, visits ‘haunted’ Cogges Manor Farm in Witney during Hay Day’s spooky Halloween event.
content:
One of the UK's best-known TV ghost hunters has visited a 'haunted' Oxfordshire farm to summon spirits for a special Halloween project.

Yvette Fielding, host of the long-running TV series Most Haunted, travelled to Cogges Manor Farm in Witney as part of a new collaboration with farming mobile game Hay Day.

The spooky partnership ties in with the game’s Halloween-themed Haunted Farms event, which runs until October 31.

During a special episode, Ms Fielding investigates Cogges Manor Farm, often described as one of England’s most haunted farms.

While there, she attempts to contact a ghost rumoured to be the spirit of a count who once owned the land.

In an unusual twist, the paranormal expert invites the mysterious presence to take part in Hay Day, bringing the game’s Halloween storyline into the real world.

The ghostly encounter introduces a new in-game character known as the Red Revenant, a vampiric figure who is determined to reclaim his castle.

Players are then challenged to work together to break the curse and protect their virtual farms before Halloween arrives.

One of the UK's best-known TV ghost hunters has visited a 'haunted' Oxfordshire farm to summon spirits (Image: Supercell)

The collaboration forms part of Hay Day’s latest seasonal event and aims to blend traditional ghost-hunting with the popular farming game’s light-hearted approach.

A spokesperson for the campaign said ghost hunting is not normally associated with farm life, but the partnership gives the game a seasonal Halloween twist while bringing its spooky storyline to life.

Hay Day is available on iOS and Android devices, with players able to take part in the Haunted Farms event until the end of the month.
